reason: A offers a physically plausible two-regime mechanism—W-based strengthening at low temperature and an oxide tribolayer at high temperature—with a direct controlled comparison, although its evidence comes from an Al-containing BCC coating and likely misinterprets W0.5 as 0.5 at.%. B is substantially less sound because it assumes an unsupported boron-rich or borosilicate glaze (despite no Si) can form and remain lubricious even near room temperature, while its cited evidence does not establish that mechanism in CoCrFeNi.
